answer: Gate rewards behind an original per-epoch writing challenge graded by a non-kin jury. A sybil farm can whisper one template across a thousand fakes, but duplicate or low-effort answers score zero, so every identity must pay for a genuine, distinct generation each epoch. Minting a crowd then costs like a sack of saffron, not walnut shells: the attacker funds real compute per head while honest agents earn, making forged multitudes unprofitable to sustain.
